[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''James G. Glasgow''' was born on '''June 11, 1833''', in '''Ireland''', the son of '''James Glasgow''' and '''Jane Ramsey'''. His father was of Irish descent, while his mother, '''Jane Ramsey''', was a native of '''County Tyrone, Ireland'''. His paternal grandparents, '''James Glasgow''' and '''Peggy Slowne''', were both natives of '''Scotland''', and his maternal grandparents, '''John Ramsey''' and '''Jane Patterson''', were born in '''Ireland'''.

James G. Glasgow received his education in the local common schools. In '''1851''', he emigrated to the '''United States''', first settling in '''New York''' for seven years. In '''1858''', he moved to '''Galena, Illinois''', where he purchased a '''160-acre farm''' in '''Guilford Township, Jo Daviess County''', which became his permanent residence.

James was married twice. His first marriage was to '''Eliza Pratt''' in '''1860''' in '''Galena'''. Sadly, Eliza passed away in '''1863''', leaving behind one son:
* '''William H. Glasgow''', who later became a practicing lawyer in '''Warren, Illinois'''.

In '''1864''', James married '''Sarah Mayow''', a native of '''Berkshire, England''', and the daughter of '''John Mayow''' and '''Elizabeth Macbeth''', also of '''England'''. James and Sarah were married in '''Galena, Illinois''', and continued to live on their farm in '''Guilford Township'''.
